overview_description.description: Ejaro is the first licensed peer-to-peer vehicle sharing marketplace in Saudi Arabia and the GCC. We connect local vehicle owners with individuals who are looking to rent vehicles whenever and wherever they want. We empower owners to earn an extra income stream from their depreciating private vehicles (assets) by sharing it with Ejaro’s trusted community.
